messages.subject: Project Falcon - completion mechanics & funds flow
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

With the SSA agreed we're set to complete on 29 May. Attached is the funds flow statement. Investor monies to reach our client account by 9.30am: Westbridge £11.0m, Calderbrook £2.0m, Aldridge Seed £1.0m. Net to company after costs is £13,847,500. We'll hold a board meeting to allot the shares and issue certificates on receipt.

Please confirm the bank details have been picked up.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
